title: FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Welcome {{name}}. This page shows tips and links tailored for your role: {{role}}.

learningDashboard.question: Learning Dashboard - what is it and how do I use it?
bullets: The dashboard gives you a snapshot of your learning activity, recent chats, enrolled courses, and progress.
Use it as your home base to jump into courses or continue learning from recommendations.
If the dashboard looks empty, enroll in a course first from My Courses.

chatAssistant.question: Chat Assistant - tips for getting useful answers
bullets: Ask clear questions about uploaded documents, course topics, or learning materials.
Upload PDFs with the plus button before asking questions about new documents.
Use the sources shown below answers to understand where the answer came from.
If the answer is not useful, ask a more specific follow-up question.

myCoursesLearner.question: My Courses - enroll, view, and continue learning
bullets: Use My Courses to view available and assigned courses.
Open a course to continue modules, quizzes, and learning activities.
If a course is missing, contact your instructor or platform administrator.

knowledgeAssessment.question: Knowledge Assessment - how it works
bullets: Knowledge assessments help check your understanding of course topics.
Read each question carefully and answer in your own words where required.
Feedback may be generated automatically and should be treated as learning support, not as a final human grade.

myDocumentsLearner.question: My Documents - preview, download, and delete
bullets: My Documents shows files uploaded by you or generated during document processing.
Use Preview before downloading to quickly check the file.
Deleting a document removes it from your document list and may remove related embeddings.

courseGenerator.question: Course Generator - create courses from documents
bullets: Upload course documents and let the platform generate course structure where supported.
Review generated modules before publishing them to learners.
Use clear file names to make course materials easier to manage later.

myCoursesInstructor.question: My Courses - view, edit, and manage courses
bullets: Use My Courses to view courses you created or manage.
Review course content before learners start using it.
Keep course titles and descriptions understandable for non-technical users.

mediaManager.question: Media Manager - managing course media
bullets: Use Media Manager for course-related images, document previews, and supporting material.
Use descriptive names so files can be recognized later.
Delete unused files carefully because learners may depend on them.

myDocumentsInstructor.question: My Documents - managing course files
bullets: Use My Documents to preview, download, and delete uploaded course files.
Preview documents before using them in course generation.
For bulk deletion, confirm carefully because embeddings and document references may also be removed.

adminDashboard.question: Admin Dashboard - platform overview
bullets: The Admin Dashboard provides platform-level overview and operational information.
Use it to understand system status, usage patterns, and administrative tasks.
Avoid changing settings unless you understand their effect on learners and instructors.

knowledgeCheckConfig.question: Knowledge Check Config - assessment settings
bullets: Use this page to configure knowledge check behavior and supported assessment settings.
Test configuration changes before applying them broadly.
Keep assessment settings simple and transparent for learners.

adminConsole.question: Admin Console - administrative actions
bullets: Use the Admin Console for restricted platform-management tasks.
Be careful with destructive actions such as deleting documents or changing system settings.
When possible, communicate major changes to affected users.

myDocumentsAdmin.question: My Documents - admin document management
bullets: Admins may use My Documents to inspect, preview, and remove uploaded documents.
Delete only documents that are clearly outdated, duplicated, or uploaded by mistake.
Use confirmation dialogs carefully because deleted embeddings may affect search and chat answers.

profileEvaluation.question: Profile & Evaluation Results
bullets: Use Profile to update your personal information, except protected fields such as email and role.
Evaluation Results show available feedback and assessment outcomes.
If something looks incorrect, contact the responsible instructor or administrator.

confirmations.question: How do confirmations and dialogs work?
bullets: Destructive actions ask for confirmation before anything is removed.
For high-risk actions such as Delete All, an extra acknowledgement may be required.
Choose No, keep it if you are unsure.

recommendations.question: Why don’t I see recommendations yet?
bullets: Recommendations may appear only after enough course, document, or assessment activity exists.
If you are a learner, start by opening courses and completing activities.
If you are an instructor, add course material first.

uploadsPreviews.question: Troubleshooting uploads and previews
bullets: Make sure uploaded files use a supported format such as PDF or Markdown.
Large files may take longer to process.
If preview fails, try refreshing the page or downloading the document instead.
